leaves.value: Pipeline config only. Workhorse UI/validation/layer schemas live in ds-data-workhorse.
Electrical constants and design standards. Set once per project, never per-transformer.
PF (cos phi) for kW to kVA conversion.
Maximum LV cable size. Cables above this are clamped. Must be in the cable_size domain.
Formula for service cable real length from geometric length x.
Fallback customer category when field data is missing.
Drop columns not listed in layers after header cleaning.
Allow customer service drops to connect to tapping poles.
Annual transformer sizing growth rates (3% years 1-5, 2% year 10).
Annual ABC cable sizing growth rates (3% years 1-5, 2% year 10).
Maximum customer-to-pole service drop length in meters.
Prefer placing earthing on poles that serve houses.
Per-transformer re-drafting knobs. Controls what gets recalculated (true) vs. kept from previous draft (false).
Pole placement, assemblies, structures, and numbering.
Default pole spacing in meters (overridden by spacing_per_cable_size).
Pass 2: redistribute poles where spans violate cable-specific max_span_m.
Equal segments (yes) or max-then-share last 2 spans (no).
Default pole material (wood / concrete / steel). Can be mixed per pole.
Recalculate cable sizes from cumulative load. False = keep user-uploaded cable sizes.
Retrace LV line topology algorithmically (longest-path). False = keep original uploaded line grouping.
Drop terminal poles (and their spans) that have zero connected customers. Existing poles are never dropped.
Break long runs of suspension assemblies by inserting strain assemblies.
Max consecutive suspension poles before inserting a strain break.
Distribute earthing every N poles within each earthing run.
Extend service cables toward customers (meters). 0 = off.
Retry previously unconnected customers during network processing.
Preserve uploaded LV line length values instead of recalculating from geometry.
Per-layer output schema + domain references. Shared domains are referenced by name from the 'domains' section.
Value domains for data cleaning and load assignment. Accepts = misspelling mappings from field surveys.
Dependency graph for per-transformer settings. Frontend uses this to auto-enable required settings, hide irrelevant ones, and warn about conflicts.
These settings MUST be true when this setting is enabled — otherwise results are inconsistent. Frontend should auto-check them.
These settings become visible/relevant ONLY when this setting is enabled. Frontend should hide them otherwise.
Settings in the same cascade group form a dependency chain (top requires all below it). Disabling one breaks the chain.
Pipeline execution order. Lower = earlier. Settings at the same stage are independent.
Adds intermediate poles at cable-specific max_span_m. New poles need assembly/structure/stay/earthing calculation and renumbering. Spans are re-split.
Only meaningful when spacing_per_cable_size is enabled. Controls placement mode: equal segments vs. max-then-share.
Rebuilding spans changes pole angles → assemblies must be recalculated. New span count → renumber.
Assembly type determines structure type and stay requirements. Changing assembly without updating structure/stay leaves them stale.
Leaf setting — structure type is derived from assembly type. No further dependencies.
Leaf setting — stay wire assignment is derived from assembly type. No further dependencies.
Earthing uses evenly_distribute_ones() based on pole_number ordering. Renumbering without re-distributing earthing leaves gaps or clusters.
Leaf setting — earthing placement depends on pole numbering and house connections.
Leaf setting — renumbers customers based on from_tr_distance.
Input-boundary setting. Previously unconnected customers are retried as normal customer points before network building.
Rebuilding service cables changes pole-customer connections → house numbers must be recalculated.
Extending service cables changes their geometry and potentially pole-customer assignments. Requires regeneration and renumbering.
Runs after all modifications. No dependencies — it only reads the final state.
Final cleanup step. Drops columns not in layer schema. No dependencies.
Default pole spacing used in Pass 1 (build_lv_networks). Overridden per-cable when spacing_per_cable_size is enabled.
Retrace LV line topology algorithmically. When false, keeps original uploaded line grouping. Independent of pole calculations.
Controls whether cable sizes are recalculated from cumulative load or kept from upload.
Modifies assembly_type column. Requires override_assemblies to be active.
Only meaningful when break_suspensions is enabled.
Controls earthing spacing. Used inside evenly_distribute_ones(). Requires override_earthing.
Pole material. Independent — does not affect any calculation, only labels.
Fallback customer category. Applied during data cleaning before network building. Independent.
Max service drop length. Applied during customer-to-pole assignment. Independent.
Preserve supplied LV line lengths during sketch/draft export. Independent.
Controls earthing preference strategy. Used inside assign_earthing(). Independent toggle.
Dependency chains — disabling any link requires disabling everything above it in the chain.
Named workflow presets. Each template overrides defaults.transformer. Empty overrides = use base defaults as-is. Dot-path keys match defaults.transformer structure.
Design from scratch. All calculations enabled.
Import existing network. Preserve uploaded data, clean + validate only.
Read-only validation and export. No modifications.
